column1: # Dual-OTA app slots plus a large filesystem. Sizing rationale and the
# reasoning that rejected EasyMCU's 10 MB byte-per-key `nvs` partition live in
# an open question on map #1 ("What the ~10 MB storage partition is for")
# `storage` is deliberately sized large and left unclaimed.
# Offsets are explicit so that alignment is checkable by eye:
#   ota_0/ota_1 start on 64 KB boundaries and are multiples of 64 KB
#   app partition and the OTA data partition both require.
